- Bovine: Bovine leather is renowned for its strength and versatility, making it ideal for a wide range of products. Its durability and classic appearance have made it a staple in both fashion and everyday items.
 Care 
 Bovine leather needs regular care to stay durable.
- Brush off any dust and dirt.
- Clean with a damp cloth.
- Apply a leather cream to keep the material hydrated.
- Clean the soles with a brush and mild soap.
- Polish the footwear with a soft cloth.
- Store with shoe trees to maintain shape.
